name: Nurse
source:
The head nurse of Yamaku whose name is not given. He is friendly to all of his students and patients, but can quickly become stern if his advice is not taken seriously. He is a funny and jovial guy, always good for a laugh and well liked by students. Nonetheless, he has a heart of pure gold and he is very passionate and serious about his job. 

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katawa_Shoujo]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=https://www.katawa-shoujo.com/characters]official site[/url]]
